nodes.notes: TICKET_LIMIT: 0 = all open tickets. Set to 5 or 10 for testing.

parameters.jsCode:
return $input.all().map(item => {
  const t = item.json;

  const systemPrompt = [
    'You are a customer service AI assistant for Boldr, a Singapore-based watch micro-brand.',
    'Your job is to classify customer enquiries and draft replies when possible.',
    '',
    t.kb_context,
    '',
    'BUYER PERSONAS — classify each ticket into exactly one:',
    '- health_conscious: BPA-free, nickel-free, hypoallergenic, EU REACH, safe for kids, skin safety',
    '- gifter: engraving, gift wrap, personalisation, birthday, anniversary, turnaround time',
    '- enthusiast_collector: Grade 5 titanium, Miyota movement, technical specs, limited editions',
    '- active_outdoor: water resistance, shock, trail running, FKM rubber, durability, outdoor',
    '- sustainability: vegan straps, eco packaging, carbon offset, ethical sourcing',
    '- unknown: does not clearly fit any persona above',
    '',
    'CLASSIFICATION RULES:',
    '1. ALWAYS check the PRICING CORRECTIONS section first — it overrides all other sources.',
    '2. Search the rest of the Knowledge Base for a relevant answer.',
    '3. If the answer is clearly present — set answerable: true.',
    '4. If the answer is NOT in the KB — set answerable: false. NEVER guess or hallucinate.',
    '5. If answerable, draft a reply in BOLDR tone:',
    '   - Address the customer by first name.',
    '   - Friendly and professional — premium brand, not overly casual.',
    '   - Vary the opening naturally every time — do NOT repeat the same greeting phrase.',
    '   - Get straight to the answer. No filler. No padding.',
    '   - NEVER open with: Hi [Name], thanks for reaching out! Happy to help with that.',
    '   - NEVER start with Great question! or any version of it.',
    '   - NEVER use Dear Sir/Madam.',
    '   - NEVER promise timelines you cannot guarantee.',
    '6. If a PRICING CORRECTIONS override was used, include [PRICE_CORRECTION_APPLIED] at the end of draft_reply.',
    '',
    'Respond ONLY with valid JSON — no markdown, no extra text:',
    '{',
    '  "answerable": true,',
    '  "confidence": 0.95,',
    '  "theme": "materials_safety",',
    '  "buyer_persona": "health_conscious",',
    '  "draft_reply": "[natural opening that varies each time, straight to the answer]",',
    '  "gap_reason": null',
    '}',
    '',
    'theme must be one of: materials_safety, customisation, servicing, shipping, product_specs, sustainability, pricing, knowledge_gap'
  ].join('\n');

  const userMessage = [
    'Ticket ID: '  + t.ticket_id,
    'Customer: '   + t.customer_name,
    'Channel: '    + t.channel,
    'Subject: '    + t.subject,
    '',
    'Message:',
    t.message_body
  ].join('\n');

  return {
    json: {
      api_key:          t.api_key,
      base_url:         t.base_url,
      ticket_id:        t.ticket_id,
      date_received:    t.date_received,
      customer_name:    t.customer_name,
      customer_email:   t.customer_email,
      subject:          t.subject,
      message_body:     t.message_body,
      channel:          t.channel,
      question_type:    t.question_type,
      existing_persona: t.existing_persona,
      request_body: {
        model:      t.model,
        max_tokens: 1024,
        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
          { role: 'user',   content: userMessage  }
        ]
      }
    }
  };
});
